reader_summary.overview: with Greg Lynn (@greglynnform), Gina Neff (@ginasue), Tracy Young (@Tracy_Young). So how are new technologies (finally!) beginning to transform the most brick-and-mortar of all the (literally!) brick-and-mortar industries? This episode of the a16z Podcast -- with Tracy Young, co-founder and CEO of PlanGrid; Greg Lynn, architect, professor at UCLA, and co-founder of Piaggio Fast Forward.
